ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.

20. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
